baseline.method: Reproduced author linear spectral unmixing and apparentSO2, not actual oxygenation truth

reference_kind: Independent standard-method reproduction; no actual Hb or oxygenation truth
threshold_rationale: Original independent reruns equal; nonzero1e-7 dynamicrangeNRMSE tolerance for numerical portability plus1.01original spectral relative residual. Every Hb/HbO2/saturation field is scored over all76cycles/fixed1955pixels.
spectral_relative_residual_definition: L2norm(sum_c coefficient_c*spectrum_c-observed_image)/L2norm(observed_image), all76cycles/10wavelengths and fixed authorROI support.
residual_precision: All final evaluation/presentation norms use float64; preimplementation capture denominator used float32 norm, changing R by4.4e-9. Frozen boundary unchanged.
